notes:

Search results no longer jump up when Start, Chats and Libraries disappear
Section headings like Today and Yesterday stay visible as their meetings scroll past

When searching, a meeting's name stays visible while its matching lines scroll by

notes:
### Fixed

- **A long meeting's summary is written again.** With a model that writes long answers, such as Claude Sonnet, the summary of a long meeting could fail with "The model's answer could not be read as notes" after trying twice. The summary, and Clean Up and Translate All with the text model, are no longer held to a fixed length: each model writes up to its own limit, and an answer that is still cut short is read again in two parts. **Best with Lumi 1.104.0**, which holds each answer to its own model's limit.

en.headline: Summaries of long meetings now complete successfully
items: Summaries of long meetings no longer fail with an error about the answer being unreadable
Clean Up and Translate All also handle longer answers without failing
Each model now writes up to its own limit instead of a fixed length
Answers that are cut short are automatically read in two parts

notes:
### Fixed

- **The call-ended card shows its buttons in full.** Continue Recording no longer sits on the card's edge: the buttons have a row of their own under the words, and the meeting's name gets the card's whole width. The countdown also runs on once the pointer leaves the card, where it could stay stopped.
- **Listen Again no longer says "Stopping…" for good after Lumi restarts.** If Lumi quit, restarted for an update or crashed while a meeting was heard again, or Meeting Notes was switched off, the meeting showed "Stopping…" with no way out for a quarter of an hour. It now opens as it was left, and Listen Again is there to press again. A summary being written in parts is put right the same way.
- **Up Next no longer says "Waiting to join" for a join that can't start.** If Meeting Notes was switched off or Lumi quit while Join and Take Notes waited for the call, the card went on waiting. It now offers Join and Take Notes again.
- **The menu bar stops counting a meeting Lumi cut off.** A meeting being recorded when Lumi quit or Meeting Notes was switched off is saved up to that moment as soon as Meeting Notes is back, and Live Captions says so as before.
- **The next call is offered Take Notes after a switch-off.** An offer Lumi took down no longer holds back the one for another call.

Meeting Notes starts nothing again by itself: what was cut short is a press away. **Needs Lumi 1.103.0.**

en.headline: Fixes for meetings interrupted when Lumi quits or restarts
items: The call-ended card shows its buttons in full on their own row
Listen Again no longer gets stuck saying Stopping after Lumi restarts
Up Next no longer says Waiting to join for a join that cannot start
The menu bar stops counting a meeting that was cut off when Lumi quit
The next call is offered Take Notes after Meeting Notes is switched off

Cuộc gọi tiếp theo được đề xuất Ghi Chú sau khi Meeting Notes bị tắt

notes:
### Added

- **One person heard as two is put right as you name them.** When Lumi gives one person two speaker numbers, name the second after the first: pick them in the list, type their name or address, or type Your Name. The card asks **Merge Speaker 2 into Lan Pham?**, says what becomes of the lines, and **Merge** makes the two one speaker. It works in Live Captions while the meeting is recorded, in the inspector and beside a name in the transcript. What that speaker says afterwards goes to the same person, and Undo takes it back. A merge saves no voice profile.

### Changed

- **Everyone invited stays in the naming list.** Someone another speaker is already named after is no longer left out: their avatar takes that speaker's colour, and the row says which speaker they are.
- **Merge Into works while a meeting is recorded.** Assign To still waits until the meeting ends.

### Fixed

- **Translate All with Apple Translation no longer stops at a line in two languages.** Such a line is translated a few sentences at a time, each from its own language, and the lines after it are translated too.
- **A meeting's last lines are kept when saving them at the end fails for a moment.** The captions panel sends them again until they are saved, with a model switch or the first translation made in the last seconds.
- **A meeting is no longer ended as lost while Lumi asks a question before it starts listening.** If the question stayed up for more than a minute and a half, the meeting was closed, and the recording that followed could not be stopped from the menu bar.
- **Join and Take Notes no longer starts notes for tomorrow's meeting.** For a call more than 4 hours away, Meeting Notes says it cannot wait that long and opens nothing.
- **Try Again and Regenerate work in a chat across meetings.**
- **Cancel stops a download that Download and Start began in Live Captions.** If Lumi cannot stop it, the panel says why.

en.headline: Merge speakers, translate mixed-language lines, and more fixes
items: You can now merge speakers when Lumi splits one person into two numbers
Everyone invited now appears in the naming list, even if already assigned
Translate All no longer stops at lines that mix multiple languages
The last lines of a meeting are kept even if saving fails briefly
Meetings are no longer closed while Lumi asks a question before listening starts
Join and Take Notes no longer opens notes for meetings more than 4 hours away

Cuộc họp không còn bị đóng khi Lumi hỏi trước khi bắt đầu nghe
Tham Gia và Ghi Chú không còn mở ghi chú cho cuộc họp cách xa hơn 4 giờ

notes:
### Added

- **Up Next on the Start page.** Your calendar's next meetings, as far ahead as Settings › Calendar › Up Next says: Today, Today and Tomorrow (the default), Next 7 Days, or Don't Show. The next one is a card with its people and one button, **Join and Take Notes** (**Take Notes** for a meeting in a room). Press a later one to see its people, its agenda and the last meeting of its series. **Needs Lumi 1.102.0.**
- **Join and Take Notes waits for the join.** It opens the call, and the notes start only once the call's app, or a browser on its site, is using the microphone and playing sound, so the lobby and the wait are left out. Until then the card says "Waiting to join" with Cancel, and so does Lumi's menu.
- **A Calendar pane in Settings.** Access, the calendars read, Name Meetings After Calendar Events and Up Next, in a pane of their own after General.

### Changed

- **The card after a call ends counts down.** When the call's app lets go of the microphone, the card says "The Zoom call ended — Saving “Design Review” in 20 s" around a ring, with **Keep Recording** and **Save Now**, and **Show More** for what was heard. Nothing is saved while you point at the card or press in it.
- **Get Started is ticked off by you.** **Mark All Done** puts it away, and the tour ticks itself at its end. The Start page's header and foot stay put while its columns scroll.
- **The meeting's toolbar.** Ask comes first and shares a capsule with Details; Appearance and Search each stand alone, in the same place on every page.

### Fixed

- **A pop-up's second press closes its menu.** Pressing the button of an open menu — the source pop-up above Start in Live Captions, Settings' model pop-ups, Template or Model in a summary, a line's More — closed the menu and opened it again, or left it open. It now only closes it, as a Mac pop-up does.
- **"“X” ended N minutes ago" no longer cuts into a meeting that runs over.** It came five minutes after the event's end while the call was still on. It now also waits until nothing has been said for two minutes, and says so.

notes:
### Added

- **A line said in another language shows which.** In a meeting in English, a line said in Vietnamese starts with a small "VI"; point at it for the language's whole name. VoiceOver reads each line in its own language's voice, in Live Captions too.

### Changed

- **Names, times and avatars follow the text size.** ⌘+ and ⌘− now size a speaker's name, time and avatar and the Translate chip with the words, so a name never reads smaller than its translation. In Paragraphs, translations hang off a thin bar, so they no longer read as a second paragraph by the same speaker.
- **Plainer words for the transcript as it was made.** "Heard live" and "as heard" are now **Original**: "Originally Speaker 2" on a struck name in Changes, **Copy Original Transcript**, "Back to Original." After Listen Again, the foot says "1 new speaker found" where it said "1 speaker told apart again".

### Fixed

- **A line and its translation light up as clearly in Dark as in Light.** Pointing at a sentence lit it and its translation only faintly in Dark. The highlight is now as strong as Apple's own in each appearance, a lit translation takes the text's colour, and Playing and Selected are stronger in Dark so Selected still stands out most.

notes:
### Added

- **Narrow a question across all your meetings.** Four chips above the field on the Chats page pick what the question reads:
  - **When:** today, yesterday, this or last week, this month, or a range of days picked on a calendar.
  - **People:** the meetings where they spoke, or only what they said.
  - **Meetings:** any you pick.
  - **Reads:** transcripts and summaries, summaries only, or transcripts only.

  Beside the chips, how many meetings that is. A question says above it what it read, and a chat keeps what its last question read when you open it again. **Needs Lumi 1.101.0.**
- **Ask about several meetings at once.** ⌘-click meetings in the sidebar, or ⇧-click for a run of them, then press **Ask About These**. Right-click a folder for **Ask About This Folder**. Chats opens with those meetings picked.

### Changed

- **Asking across all your meetings reads their summaries too.** A meeting's summary goes in beside its transcript when it is written, edited or another version is shown, and comes out when it is deleted. Questions such as "every decision we made" or "all the upcoming deadlines" now find more of what was said. Summaries written before this go in over your next few questions across meetings.

### Fixed

- **A long meeting from an earlier version opens again.** Opening one stopped with "storage.put refused: this run already made 200 host calls" after an update, because each sentence's language was asked of Lumi one at a time. They are now asked all at once. **Needs Lumi 1.101.0.**
- **A cite in an answer across all your meetings shows when it was said.** Every such chip read "00:00" and the meeting's title with the date after it. It now shows the line's own time and the meeting's title as it is now, and is greyed once that meeting is deleted. While the answer is still being written, it is already that meeting's chip rather than a greyed link.

Citations in answers across meetings now show the correct time and meeting title

notes:
### Added

- **Slash commands in Ask.** Type `/` in Ask, or press the `/` button beside @, to pick a command:
  - **Lumi's own:** `/clear` starts a new chat and keeps this one, `/compact` summarizes the earlier messages, `/retry` asks the last question again, `/title` renames the chat, and `/think` sets how hard it thinks.
  - **Meeting Notes' own:** `/actions`, `/decisions`, `/open` and `/email [to whom]`.
  - **In Live Captions:** also `/missed`, `/sofar` and `/suggest`.
  - **Needs Lumi 1.100.0.**
- **Back and Forward.** After a citation, a mention or a quote opens something else, ‹ and › at the start of the toolbar take you back to what you were reading, and forward again. ⌘[ and ⌘] do the same. A chat comes back scrolled to where you left it. In Live Captions, Ask has them at the top of the chat.

### Changed

- **A citation is a small token,** set after the punctuation it belongs to, as a footnote mark is. A long name is cut short, and its tooltip says it in full.

### Fixed

- A citation of a chat or a meeting that has since been deleted is struck through. It used to be only dimmed.
- In Live Captions, a citation, a mention or a quote of another meeting's chat opens Meeting Notes on that chat. It used to do nothing.
- Back to Summary shows only when you went from the summary to a line, and not when the transcript was already open.

notes:

notes:
### Added

- **Ask AI.** Ask about a meeting while it is happening or after it, and get an answer that cites the lines it came from: press a citation to open the meeting at that line. Ask stands beside or under the transcript in the window (⌘J), and folds under Live Captions, where What Did I Miss?, Summary So Far and Suggest a Question are one press away. Lumi's assistant answers with the AI you set up in Lumi, keeps your chats on this Mac, and asks before anything leaves it. Needs Lumi 1.98.0.
- **Chats.** Lumi names each chat from its first answer; in the window, press its name to rename it. Every chat of every meeting is on the Chats page, where you can also ask across all your meetings and select many chats to delete at once. Branch in New Chat goes on from any answer; @ mentions another chat and Quote brings a message into your question; Summarize Earlier Messages shortens a long chat.
- **Files and libraries.** Drop, paste or add files to a chat, and an answer cites the place in them, shown in a preview. The Libraries page keeps files in libraries, laid out as Finder does; mention a library with @ and the chat searches it.
- **Settings › Ask:** where Ask stands, the model a new chat asks and how hard it thinks, the language it answers in, Suggested Questions, About Me, and how long chats are kept, with Delete All Chats….
- **⌘+ ⌘− ⌘0** make a chat's words bigger, smaller and back, as Mail does.

### Changed

- **The live captions' ⋯ menu is shorter and changes things in place.** Appearance (Dark, Light or Match macOS), Text Size and Visible Lines are one row each, three buttons to pick from, and a new Opacity row sets the Background Opacity, filled as far as the captions are opaque. Each moves the captions as you choose and leaves the menu up. Click Through Captions is in the menu too, beside Speaker Labels and Show My Captions. Speech Model is one line naming the model in use; press it for the list. Open Meeting Notes and Settings… are at the foot.
- **Captions can be drawn in a colour of your own.** Text Color and Translation Color, in ⋯ and in Settings › Captions, each offer Yellow, Green, Blue and Pink beside the default, every one in a shade that reads on the captions' dark or light background; a colour you pick follows the captions when their Appearance changes.
- **The 文A button shows Live Translation is on by its colour**, on no blue ground of its own.

### Fixed

- Opening a meeting no longer opens its title for editing.
- A transcript line's language is read from its words, not from the language the model heard.
- A menu lights one row at a time, and none until the pointer or a key reaches it.

notes:
### Added

- **An event's notes in the inspector.** The agenda or anything else written in the notes of the event a meeting is linked to shows under the event, in Notes: its first eight lines and Show All, selectable to copy. What Teams, Zoom or Google Meet pastes under it — the link, the meeting ID, the passcode, the dial-in numbers — is folded under Joining Info until you open it. A meeting linked to its event before this has the notes read the first time you open it. Needs Lumi 1.97.0.
- **A summary says who wrote it.** “Summarized by Claude Opus in Lumi Meeting Notes” — the model that wrote it, or AI where it isn’t known — stands on its own line over the footnote under every summary, Lumi’s mark before it.

### Changed

- **A summary being written shows Lumi's mark**, the bolt in its diamond, painted in the colours of the ring turning round it, where the ✦ stood. No Summary Yet has it too.
- **The summary's mark moves between its places instead of jumping.** Summarize in No Summary Yet glides the mark up to where it works; its bolt flashes and a diamond grows out of it, turning square, into the ring that turns while the summary is written. Stop, from the middle of the page or from the line over the notes, glides it back down as it is, and once it is there the ring shrinks into the diamond as it turns; a run that fails goes back into Couldn't Write the Summary the same way. The line over the notes fades where it stood once the summary is kept or a Regenerate is stopped, and the notes slide into its room — as they slide and dim when a Regenerate's line comes in over them. The ring slows as the model thinks, and stands faint while it waits on you, from the angle it is at rather than jumping to another. With Reduce Motion on, each is simply there.
- **A summary written from the refined transcript says only that** under it, without “heard again”.

### Fixed

- **With Reduce Motion on, the summary's mark holds still while the model thinks.** Its glow went on turning and breathing.
- **Open works right after Meeting Notes is updated.** For a few seconds after an update, the windows it loads ahead took every call it could make at once, and opening Meeting Notes was refused.

notes:
### Added

- **Name a speaker right in Live Captions.** Click their name and a popover opens above the captions, which hold still while you type. Click outside to keep the name; Cancel or Escape keeps nothing.
- **Speakers carry their email address**, from the invitation or typed with the name. The inspector and exported minutes show it, a merge takes it along, and a voice profile keeps it (Settings › Speakers › Edit).
- **Rest the pointer on a person to see their card**, as in Microsoft Teams: what the meeting knows of them — the invitation, the lines they said, their voice profile — and their email address, which a press copies.
- **Hide Invited, in Export’s Customization**, leaves the people invited out of exported minutes. Who spoke is still listed.

### Changed

- **Choose what Live Captions hears above Start Transcription** — where it listens, the languages, the speech model — and name the meeting before it starts, after the calendar event on now. A missing model is one press, Download and Start, with its progress in the button. Starting keeps the captions as they were, a paused meeting has one Resume, and menus open under the button you press.
- **The inspector is a Mac inspector’s form**: rounded groups under titles, Speakers second, each speaker’s Name and Merge Into as buttons on its row. Duration counts up while a meeting is heard, and a meeting that invited more than ten people lists ten and Show All.
- **Naming a speaker offers the people invited as a list you find in**, in the window and in Live Captions: type, or use ↓, ↑ and Return. It stays five rows high however many were invited. The name you pick becomes a chip; take it away with its × or Backspace before typing another.
- **Avatars show two letters, as Teams draws them**, for speakers and the people invited, who each keep a colour of their own.
- **Translate beside a bubble or a line translates it, shows it, or translates it again**, and leaves Show Translations as it is.
- **Scroll to Top and Scroll to Bottom show while you scroll**, and go a moment after you stop.
- **A summary item’s menu has icons**, and the summary’s footnote asks you to double-check what the AI wrote.

### Fixed

- **A meeting whose recording failed or was cut off can be scrubbed through again**; it was kept as 0 s long. Meetings already affected mend when they open.
- **Cancelling a start leaves no meeting behind**, and Live Captions shows Start again once the meeting opens in the window, not “Saved”.
- **Resume under paused captions takes a click with Click Through Captions on.**
- **Listen Again hears with Apple Speech when you choose it**, and says why when another model must. Settings and Live Captions say so too when a Second Language rules Apple Speech out.
- **Only the line under the pointer shows its buttons.** Lines already in the language you translate into show no Translate, and Clean Up, Listen Again and Translate All show their progress on the Transcript tab alone.

notes:
### Added

- **Words While Speaking**, in Settings › Transcription: choose the model that writes the grey words while someone talks — Apple Speech, or Nemotron 3.5 Streaming, which hears both of a meeting's languages. Speech Recognition still writes each line when they pause, so the words come steadily and the graphics chip is mostly free for the call, though they're less accurate until the pause. Same as Speech Recognition, as before, is the default; a model not on this Mac downloads when you pick it, and a change applies from the next meeting. Needs Lumi 1.95.
- **Translate While Speaking**, in Settings › Translation: with Live Translation on, each sentence is translated before the speaker pauses, as before. Turn it off to translate only each finished line.

### Changed

- **Chat shows a line's actions as you point at it**: Play, Translate, Copy and More beside the bubble, as Paragraphs and Lines show them. The View popover's help is one line.
- **Click a line to play it**, and again to pause it, under the pointing hand; ⌘-click or ⇧-click selects lines. A click used to select and a double-click to play. A line with no audio still selects on a click.
- **Play is Pause while its line plays**, in every layout, and Play again goes on where it stopped. The bars that show a turn playing stand at the speaker's outer edge in Chat, and in place of the speaker's initial in Paragraphs and Lines, so nothing moves when a line starts or stops, and Name… coming and going under the pointer leaves no gap beside them.
- **Your own turns in Chat read "0:32 Me"**, your name at the bubble's edge as other speakers' names are at theirs.
- **Chat's bubbles stop at a comfortable line length** on a wide window — about 65 characters, at every text size.
- **Unlink a meeting's event by pressing it again** in the event menu, where it is ticked; None is gone.
- **In Live Captions, a speaker not known yet is three blinking dots**, as the main window shows words still being heard, where a still "…" stood.

### Fixed

- **A turn says which sentences are not translated yet.** In Chat and Paragraphs, a sentence with no translation shows Translate where its translation would be, a press away; half a turn's translation read as all of it.
- **A finished meeting opens at its start**, not on its last lines. A meeting being transcribed still follows what is said.
- **The bar for several selected lines no longer hides the last ones.**
- In Chat, words fade under the speaker's name as they scroll past it, rather than being cut at its edge.
- **The event menu fits what it holds.** With no event near the meeting it is its heading and Open in Calendar, no wider than they are.
- **With translations beside the words, each language's name stands over its column**, in Lines and Paragraphs. On a wide window the original language's name stood well left of its words.

notes:
### Added

- **Merge speakers and assign lines.** When one person was heard as two, right-click a line and choose Merge “Speaker 3” Into, or press Merge… beside the speaker in the inspector. When a line went to the wrong person, Assign To moves it — or every selected line — to anyone in the meeting, to you, or to a New Speaker. Both have Undo, and both wait until the meeting ends.

### Fixed

- **Name… opens its card whole**, in the transcript over the turns below it — upward near the transcript's foot — and in the inspector, with no scrollbar of its own. In Lines, a turn's header now holds at the top as you scroll, and its text follows View's size.

notes:
### Added

- **A Welcome tour on a fresh install.** The microphone and system audio, your language and its speech model (downloading in the background), your calendar, your name, Keep Audio and summaries, and the keys that start a meeting. Again from Settings › About › Welcome Tour….
- **Pin and folders.** Right-click a meeting to Pin it or Move To a folder, or drag it there. New Folder (⇧⌘N) is named in place, folders keep the order you drag them, and Delete Folder keeps its meetings, with Undo. Sort By date, title or length. The meeting being transcribed stays at the top, in Now.
- **Export… (⇧⌘E) makes a PDF, HTML, Markdown or plain text file** from one sheet: a template — Standard, Minutes or Columns — and the paper; the summary, any version of it, or Summarize… or Regenerate… there; the transcript refined or as heard, its translations (Translate… if there are none yet) and timestamps. Customization names you another way in that file, or leaves out the AI models' names. The preview is the file: PDF and HTML zoom, Markdown and plain text copy — Markdown's Formatted view as rich text. An HTML file has its own Light, Dark and System. Every file ends with "Made with Lumi Meeting Notes". Saved, the message names the file and its folder, with Show in Finder.
- **Your Name in place of "Me"** in every meeting, earlier ones too: Settings › Speakers › Your Name.
- **Quick Translate.** In a meeting with nothing translated, the translate button translates it at once into your Settings' language with your translator, a ring round it showing how far.
- **Meetings named after their calendar events** (Settings › General › Calendar). The event button beside the date links another event or opens it in Calendar; the inspector shows who was invited. Reads your calendar, never changes it.
- **Offers for meetings in a room** as a calendar event with a place starts (Settings › General › Offer For › In-Person Meetings); a call still heard 5 minutes after its event ends offers Stop and Save.
- **Add to Reminders** from the Action Items heading: the items you tick, with a date. Done in Reminders shows done here.

### Changed

- **The sidebar slides** out and in (⌘B), its button beside New Folder.
- **The window shows its name**, Lumi Meeting Notes, at the middle of its title bar.

### Fixed

- **Settings › Storage** gives the transcripts' size without the audio, always shows the Audio section, and Delete All Audio works with hundreds of meetings.
- **Messages** stay at the middle of the window's foot.
- **The Summary tab** shows a spinner, not No Summary Yet, while the summary is read.

Needs Lumi 1.94.0.

notes:
### Added

- **Refine and Translate.** In the Transcript tab, Refine and Translate… cleans up a meeting that has ended. Light takes out ums and words said twice, on this Mac, with no AI. Full also fixes punctuation, grammar and your Custom Vocabulary terms with the text model you choose, and leaves out any change that would alter what was said. Translate All translates every line not yet translated, or all of them again once every line is. The sheet says how long it takes and which AI calls go where before you start; Stop keeps what's done.
- **Original, Changes and Refined.** See the refined words, what refining changed — taken out struck through, put in underlined — or the words as heard. Revert to Original puts lines, or the whole meeting, back as heard. ⌘Z undoes the last refine or revert, and ⇧⌘Z redoes it. Copy and Export take the version shown.
- **Listen Again.** Hears a meeting's kept audio again with a stronger speech model on this Mac, for truer words and speakers: on a call your lines stay Me, and someone the live transcript mixed up is told apart. The words heard live stay as Original, and the summary's times follow the new lines.
- **Meetings clean themselves up as they end.** Settings › Transcription › After a Meeting: Light by default, for meetings of 3 minutes or more; Full and Listen Again can follow, with the models you choose.
- **Volume in the player.** A speaker button mutes playback; hover over it for a volume slider.
- **⌘B shows or hides the sidebar.**
- **A Changelog tab** beside About on Meeting Notes' page in Lumi's Settings.

### Changed

- **Start Transcription shows Live Captions and closes the Meeting Notes window**, wherever you press it, so you follow the meeting over the call; open Meeting Notes again to read along. To keep the window, set Settings › General › When Transcription Starts to Keep Window Open.
- **Show Translations beside View.** A translate button shows or hides translations, and turns Live Translation on or off while a meeting is heard.
- **Summary choices wait for Regenerate.** A new template, model or language no longer rewrites the summary at once.
- **Icons in the meeting menus**, as macOS menus have them.

### Fixed

- **Settings… opens Meeting Notes Settings.** With the Meeting Notes window in front, Meeting Notes › Settings… and ⌘, open its Settings window and leave the window where it is.
- **The View and date popovers open over the transcript**, no longer under a speaker's name held at the top.

notes:
### Added

- **Escape closes Settings.** A menu or a sheet open in it, a shortcut being recorded, or a field you're typing in takes Escape first; press it again to close the window.

### Changed

- **A summary writes itself in as the model writes it.** While the transcript is read, the Summary tab shows what's happening where "No Summary Yet" stood, with Stop, and a long meeting's progress fills the ring round its mark. When the model starts writing, the mark moves up to a line that stays at the top as you scroll, and the overview and each item appear as they're written. Regenerate keeps the summary you have, dimmed, until the new one starts.
- **Live Translation keeps up with a long turn.** Each sentence is translated as soon as it's said, while the speaker goes on, instead of once they pause; the rest of the caption follows when it ends. A sentence heard differently a moment later is translated again. With macOS translating (Settings › Translation Engine), the words still being said are translated too, dimmed, and replaced as more is said, then by the caption's own translation when it ends; the AI is never asked for these.
- **Live Captions are ready from the moment Lumi starts**, as the menu bar item's panel is, so the first meeting shows them at once. Lumi's Preload switch for Meeting Notes covers them too.
- **Live Captions step out of the way while you're in the Meeting Notes window watching the meeting being heard**, since the window already shows its words, and come back over every app as soon as you switch to another app or close the window (closing needs Lumi 1.93.0). Start or Resume pressed in the window starts the meeting from there, without the captions flashing up first. Captions you hid yourself stay hidden, and they stay put while Live Translation is by the AI.
- **A meeting is summarized by itself as it ends.** Settings › Summaries' Automatically Summarize When a Meeting Ends, on unless you turn it off, writes the summary with the Default Template as the Meeting Notes window opens on a meeting of 3 minutes or more, in place of Offer to Summarize; Lumi's card at a call's end offers Resume. Set as Default under Templates picks the template.
- **Templates says which are built in**: they're listed under BUILT-IN, yours under YOUR TEMPLATES. A built-in opens with View…, and − says why it can't delete one.
- **The menu bar item's panel has no Live Captions or Live Translation switch any more.** Show Live Captions appears there while you record and the captions are out of sight, and the Meeting Notes window's translate button turns Live Translation on and off while it shows the meeting being heard.
- **A meeting that ends opens in the Meeting Notes window**, and Live Captions go away, instead of staying up to say it was saved: stopped, ended after a pause, or stopped by itself when the call ended.

### Fixed

- **The menu bar item no longer goes on showing a recording after it stopped**: now and then its wave kept moving beside a clock standing at the meeting's last second, with nothing being heard.

notes:

- **Choose how the transcript reads.** View, beside the tabs, lays it out as Chat (bubbles, yours on the right, as Messages draws them), Paragraphs or Lines, with translations below the words or side by side, four text sizes (⌘+ ⌘−), and Timestamps, Follow Along While Playing and Speaker Colors.

- **Follow along while it plays**: the line heard is lit and kept in sight; scroll away and Back to Now Playing returns to it.
- **See who spoke where on the player's scrubber**: point at it and the turn under the pointer lights up, with a tooltip naming the speaker, the time a click plays from, and when the turn starts and ends. ⇧-click plays the turn from its start.
- **Appearance in the toolbar**: a click goes System, Light, Dark; right-click to pick one. The same setting as Settings › General.
- **Every speech model that heard a meeting**, with when it took over, in Details, under the title and in exports.
- **Search finds what was said** in every meeting's transcript, translations and summary. The sidebar shows the meetings that hold your words, their matches and two of their lines: click one to open the meeting there. Without accents a word finds every accent ("hop" finds họp, hộp and hợp); quotes keep a phrase in order.
- **Move from match to match** with ‹ › beside the search, Return or ⌘G (⇧⌘G back), the summary's matches included; each tab says how many it holds. ⌘F goes to the search.
- **Click Through Captions**, in Settings › Live Captions: the captions' text lets clicks, scrolls and hovers through to what's under it; the bar and the panel's edges still take them.
- **Keys for Start, Pause and Stop Transcription**: ⌃⌥⌘1, ⌃⌥⌘2 and ⌃⌥⌘3 in every app, as the menu bar item's rows. Change or clear them in Settings › General › Shortcuts.

### Changed

- **Transcript and Summary are two tabs** under the meeting's title, ⌘1 and ⌘2; the title heads the page over the date and who spoke. Point at a summary's time to read its lines; click it to see them in the transcript, and Back to Summary (⌘[) to return. The player stays under both tabs, and a meeting opens on the tab you left. ⌥⌘S is gone with the pane.
- **The transcript opens as Chat**, headed by when it was heard, the model and the language, with quiets of 15 s or more said between turns. A long bubble keeps its speaker's name in sight as you scroll through it.

notes:
### Added

- **Summarize a meeting.** A Summary pane under the transcript writes an overview, the action items and the sections of a template — General, 1:1, Stand-up, Interview, Customer Call or one of your own — each item with the time it was said: click the time to see those lines in the transcript. Template, model and language are right above it; choosing another writes a new version, and the one before stays a click away with your edits. Edit any item in place, tick action items, choose who owns them; Copy Summary and Copy Action Items paste as Markdown. The summary is written by the text model you set up in Lumi, on this Mac or online — Lumi asks before anything leaves it — and the meeting takes the summary's title while it still has the one Meeting Notes gave it. Drag the pane taller or shorter, make it larger, or fold it away with ⌥⌘S. Needs Lumi 1.92.0.
- **Long meetings are read in parts** when the model you chose can't read them whole, then put together, with a bar of how far it got, the time left and Stop. A stretch that couldn't be read is said at the top of the summary.
- **No text model yet?** Summarize offers one to download, in Lumi's own panel, and goes on once it's ready.
- **Settings › Summaries**: the Text Model, the template and language a summary starts with, and your own templates — a name, instructions, and the sections you want in your order.
- **Summarize from the card when a call ends.** For notes of 3 minutes or more, Lumi's card offers Summarize instead of Resume, and the window opens on the meeting writing it. Turn it off in Settings › Summaries.
- **Exports include the summary.** Export as Markdown or Plain Text puts the summary ahead of the transcript, each item with the time of what it came from; Share › Copy Summary copies it.

### Changed

- **The player is a bar at the foot of the transcript**, in the same place whatever the window shows, with no Close; Space plays and pauses.
- **Scroll to Top and Scroll to Bottom** appear as you scroll a long transcript or summary; Home, End, ⌘↑ and ⌘↓ go there too.
- **Alerts' buttons are drawn as macOS's**, one line each.
- **Live Captions step back while you work in Meeting Notes.** With the Meeting Notes or Settings window in use, the captions no longer cover it: they go behind it, and float over every app again as soon as you go back to another app, or when you click them. Needs Lumi 1.91.0.

Click a line's time to hear it from there, the line being heard lit, at 1×, 1.5× or 2×, and in a call **Mute Myself** plays it without your microphone; Save Audio… writes it as an .m4a, into a folder you choose in Settings or wherever you pick. Delete All Audio in Settings removes it and keeps the transcripts.
- **Long meetings**: a recording runs up to two hours by default; set **Longest Recording** in Settings, up to eight hours, and **Auto-Resume at Recording Limit** goes on in the same meeting once it is reached.
- Hints as you point at a button, a speaker or a caption, and why a button is off — in the captions panel too.
- **Notices a meeting starting**: when Microsoft Teams, Zoom, FaceTime or another call app — or Google Meet, Teams or Zoom in a browser — starts using your microphone, a **Take Notes** button comes up at the top right of your screen. Meeting Notes never starts by itself. When the call ends, the notes stop and are saved, with **Resume** if it was too soon — or it asks first, or keeps recording, as you choose in Settings, where each call app has a switch (Slack is off, since it holds the microphone outside huddles too) and the meeting sites are a list you can edit.
- Opens from its own menu bar item, or with ⌃⌥⌘M.
- Needs Lumi 1.65.0.

en.headline: Live captions for your meetings, with speaker identification
items: Captions float above your call showing who said what, with saved voice profiles by name
Set a second language and each line appears in the language it was spoken in
Click any caption to translate it, or turn on live translation for every line
Every meeting is saved as a transcript you can read, search by speaker, and export
Record your voice so your lines show as Me and Meeting Notes tells you apart from others
Keep audio with transcripts to listen back at any speed, with mute for playback during calls
